name: burrow-chat
description: Claude Code backend for the Burrow chat panel — the default chat participant, Claude models in the picker, and editor entry points.

scripts.test: node test/contextFilter.test.js && node test/styleImports.test.js && node test/packModel.test.js && node test/controls.test.js

chatParticipants.name: burrow

burrow.chat.cliPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `claude` CLI. Leave empty to resolve from PATH and the usual install locations.

burrow.chat.contextPack.enabled.description: Attach a context pack (focused artifact + repo relationships) to chat messages.

burrow.chat.workbenchContext.description: Tell the model what the Burrow workbench is showing (isolated component and its stylesheet, live database connection, routes through the active file). Paths only, re-sent within a session only when it changes.

enumDescriptions: Follow the chat Approvals control: Default asks in chat, Auto Approve approves everything.
Ask in chat before every tool use.
Auto-approve file edits; everything else asks.
Claude Code plan mode: read-only analysis, no edits or commands.
Claude Code's auto mode classifier decides.
burrow.chat.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Default permission mode for new chats (`--permission-mode`). Each chat can override this from its Approvals chip.

enumDescriptions: Whatever your Claude Code is configured to use.
burrow.chat.effort.markdownDescription: Default reasoning effort for new chats (`--effort`). Each chat can override this from its Effort chip.

enumDescriptions: Let Claude Code decide the thinking budget.
burrow.chat.thinking.markdownDescription: Default extended-thinking budget for new chats (`MAX_THINKING_TOKENS`). Each chat can override this from its Thinking chip.

burrow.chat.agent.markdownDescription: Default agent for new chats (`--agent`). Agents are read from `.claude/agents` in the workspace and in your home directory. Empty means Claude Code's own `agent` setting.

burrow.chat.fallbackModel.markdownDescription: Model(s) to fall back to when the primary is overloaded (`--fallback-model`). Comma-separated, tried in order.

burrow.chat.maxBudgetUsd.markdownDescription: Stop a run once it has spent this many dollars (`--max-budget-usd`). `0` means uncapped.

burrow.chat.systemPrompt.markdownDescription: Replace Claude Code's default system prompt entirely (`--system-prompt`). Empty keeps the default.

burrow.chat.appendSystemPrompt.default: You are the assistant inside Burrow, a Go-focused IDE. Chat attachments arrive as workspace-relative paths (with 1-based line ranges for selections); read them with your tools before answering. A context_pack block lists the artifact the user is focused on and its immediate repo relationships as workspace-relative paths; treat it as a map — answer from it directly when it suffices, and open the listed files with your tools when you need contents.
burrow.chat.appendSystemPrompt.markdownDescription: Appended to Claude Code's system prompt (`--append-system-prompt`). This is how the model learns what Burrow puts in a message; clearing it appends nothing.

burrow.chat.debug.markdownDescription: CLI debug logging (`--debug`). `true` logs everything; a filter such as `api,hooks` or `!file` narrows it. Empty is off.

burrow.chat.debugFile.markdownDescription: Write CLI debug logs to this path (`--debug-file`).

burrow.chat.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments appended verbatim to every `claude` run. Quoted strings are honoured; nothing is validated. Do not pass `--bare` — it severs the CLI's OAuth login.

burrow.chat.showUsage.description: Show each turn's token counts, cost and duration under the response.

burrow.chat.logArgs.markdownDescription: Echo the composed `claude` command line and environment overlay to the Burrow Chat output channel. For verifying that a control reached the CLI.
